# Temple Scroll Column 22 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 22 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**22:1** And you shall make a laver of copper and its base of copper, for washing; and you shall place it between the tent of meeting and the altar.

**22:2** And you shall put water in it, and Aaron and his sons shall wash their hands and their feet from it.

**22:3** When they enter the tent of meeting they shall wash with water, and they shall not die; or when they approach the altar to minister, to burn a fire-offering to Me.

**22:4** And they shall wash their hands and their feet, and they shall not die; and it shall be for them a statute forever, for him and for his seed throughout their generations.

**22:5** And you shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side, southward, hangings for the court of fine twisted linen, one hundred cubits in length for one side.

**22:6** And its pillars shall be twenty, and their bases twenty, of copper; the hooks of the pillars and their bands of silver.

**22:7** And for the north side, hangings of one hundred cubits in length; and its pillars twenty and their bases twenty of copper; the hooks of the pillars and their bands of silver.

**22:8** And for the width of the court on the west side, hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten and their bases ten.

**22:9** And for the width of the court on the east side, eastward, fifty cubits.

**22:10** Fifteen cubits of hangings for the one shoulder; their pillars three and their bases three.

**22:11** And for the second shoulder, fifteen cubits of hangings; their pillars three and their bases three.

**22:12** And for the gate of the court, a screen of twenty cubits, of blue and purple and scarlet yarn and fine twisted linen, the work of an embroiderer; their pillars four and their bases four.

**22:13** All the pillars of the court all around shall be banded with silver; their hooks of silver and their bases of copper.

**22:14** And the length of the court: one hundred cubits; and the width: fifty by fifty; and the height: five cubits, of fine twisted linen; and their bases of copper.

**22:15** All the vessels of the tabernacle for all its service, and all its pegs and all the pegs of the court — of copper.

**22:16** All of them shall be holy to Me, and they shall not profane them, for I the LORD dwell in the midst of the children of Israel.

---

*EMET notes: Column 22 well preserved. The laver and court descriptions draw on Exodus 30:17-21 and 27:9-19. "Shoulder" (katef) preserved literally for the flanking sections of the court entrance. God's first-person voice maintained throughout.*
